detail: FreeBMD, Free UK Genealogy: indexes read 16 October 2026 without an account. An INDEX: it gives name, district, volume and page, and age at death only from 1866.

Q3 1917, Hitchin, aged 54, vol 3a p607 (FreeBMD, the quarter shown as over 99 per cent transcribed). A search of England and Wales for George Castle aged 54, March 1916 to December 1917, returns this entry alone. A search of Hitchin for any George Castle, March 1916 to December 1918, returns it alone. THERE IS NO GEORGE CASTLE DEATH AT HITCHIN IN 1916.

record: Marriage, George William Castle and Caroline Wallis
detail: Q4 1882, Hitchin, vol 3a p567: CASTLE George William and WALLIS Caroline are both indexed on that one page, which is how the index shows two people married to each other. It dates the marriage to the last quarter of 1882 and the tree's 'October' sits inside it. The certificate has not been read.
Q1 1862, Hitchin, vol 3a p230: WALLIS Caroline. The only Caroline Wallis born in the Hitchin district in 1862 or 1863.

Q1 1863, Hitchin, vol 3a p247: WALLIS, Female, no forename. FOUND ONLY BY A SURNAME-ONLY SEARCH WITH THE PHONETIC OPTION; a forename search cannot return a birth registered before the child was named. Whether either entry is her is not known.

The 1939 Register gives 28 February 1863. The 1957 death index gives 1862. The 1911 census gives age 48 on 2 April 1911, which fits 1863 and not a birth on 28 February 1862. The 1921 census gives 56 years 4 months, which fits neither (it gives February 1865). An earlier note here called the 1939 date 'exact' and said the 1921 age agreed with 1863; the 1921 age does not.
Q4 1885, Hitchin, aged 46, vol 3a p249. The only George Castle death at Hitchin, 1884 to 1886. Age 46 fits a man born about 1839 to 1840.
Q3 1863 (vol 3a p188) and Q3 1865 (vol 3a p168), both Hitchin. Ages are not given before 1866, so the index cannot say which is George Castle's wife. Not resolved.

Hitchin, Q1 1883: GIDDINGS James, 68, vol 3a p257. Q2 1883: Giddings Elizabeth, 68, vol 3a p250. These fit a man and a wife both born about 1815. They are the only James and Elizabeth of that age under any spelling (phonetic search) at Hitchin from Q2 1871 to 1895. No record ties them to Norton End. Not claimed.

FreeCEN, Free UK Genealogy: census transcriptions, no account. HERTFORDSHIRE COVERAGE IS PATCHY, so a nil is not a finding. A search for Caroline WALLIS born in Hertfordshire 1861 to 1866 returned nothing. A search for the surname WALLIS born in Hertfordshire 1855 to 1870 returned 28 people, almost all from Buntingford, Braughing, Thorley, Tring and Watford; the Hitchin district gave two. One was a John Wallis, labourer, born at Weston about 1863, a lodger at Church End, Clothall in 1891 (RG12 piece 1105 folio 72). He shows that a Wallis was born at Weston in her year. He is NOT claimed as kin.

FreeREG, Free UK Genealogy: parish register transcriptions, no account. Mary BURCH baptisms in Hertfordshire 1770 to 1800: none. Surname-only BURCH baptisms in Hertfordshire 1700 to 1850: 70, across about a dozen parishes, Aldenham among them with six, all of 1812 or later. With the phonetic option on, Mary BIRCH baptisms 1765 to 1800 in Hertfordshire, Middlesex and Buckinghamshire: five fall near enough to Aldenham and late enough to be a bride of 1814 who bore a daughter in 1822: Abbots Langley 13 January 1782 (father Adam); Watford, born 27 December 1782, baptised 31 January 1783 (father Charles, mother Mary); Abbots Langley, born 26 August 1784 (father John); Great Stanmore 10 July 1791, as Mary Ann (father William, mother Rebecca); Bovingdon, born 26 August 1791 (father James, mother Rebecca). NONE IS CHOSEN. Nothing in this archive says which, or whether any, is the Mary who married at Aldenham.

FreeREG, APPLEYARD baptisms 1750 to 1800 in Hertfordshire, Middlesex and Buckinghamshire: one, an Ann at Marylebone in 1779. Mary APPLEYARD baptisms in any county 1762 to 1782: nine, ALL IN YORKSHIRE (West Riding eight, North Riding one). That is where this index finds the name, not where Mary was born. The Aldenham registers hold 18 Appleyard baptisms and FreeREG does not carry them, so this index is not the one to settle it.
